title: •Sneak Attack
caption: •Sneak Attack (V)
game_text:
USED: If opponent just initiated a battle, place a card from hand on top of Reserve Deck.
LOST: Add one battle destiny where you have an AT-ST, scout, or lone Imperial of ability < 4.
lore: Imperial training allows scouts to use speed and stealth to their advantage. On Endor, they were also backed up by Commander Igar’s AT-STs.
